newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas mixed, busy as exchange eyes new contract.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas mixed, busy as exchange eyes new contract.

text.p: The IPE natural gas contract saw mixed prices on Thursday as 290 lots traded, the fourth consecutive day of high volumes this week.

Each of the first eight months of the contract traded, from August through to March, with a total of 15 trades done. September was the busiest month with 75 lots traded, while front month August saw 50 lots done in two deals.
August, September, November and December all rose, while October, January, February and March all fell. The winter months had risen strongly in the last few days.

Stephen Barraclough, Assistant Vice President for Product Development and Research at the IPE, told an industry conference this week that the exchange hoped to have quarterly contracts in place by the end of this year.
He also said the exchange would be in a position to launch an electricity contract next year, and was still looking closely at the launch of contracts for unleaded gasoline and coal.
